title: 🍉 Legendary Joins
description: ⭐ Make the greetings on the server much more unique!
body:
![LJ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/52f66386de62f0b55f06f320b612e233da6589ec.png)

![Why](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0cff29bc3570ef9ecfa6a2dcdce0ef9846a7aca0.png)
- 📛 **Regular** updates
- 🤩 Support for the **Console** type gradient (§)
- 🍉 Support for **Regular** Minecraft colors (&)
- 🏝️ **Communication** with the audience. (Below is the information about it)
- 🔦 The ability to change **ALL** messages in the plugin. Even reload.
- ⭐ **Russian** and **English** config. (It's originally Russian, if you need an English config, look at the files for the latest versions of the plugin.)
- and much more that awaits you after installation!

![Comm](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d2c2a3232a0c626fa4bc25cd0b8deef3836f8f5.png)
- 💫 Do you have an idea for this plugin? Not a question! Write to me in private messages in the Discord messenger. **(@xaremy)**. I also have a personal telegram channel, if anyone is interested in following my life and developing projects, go there!
- ⚠️ Latest version of the plugin: **1.1.0**

[![https://modrinth.com/plugin/legendary-reports](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/13b755111c27fe7628cda53e3e0a7859328e78f5.png)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/legendary-reports)
